economic_primitives.decision_minute: t (completed-minute convention; the flat-state decision minute)
economic_primitives.entry_fill: BUY decided at completed minute t fills at completed minute e=t+1 at executable ask A_e (per-share option price, index points); no A_e means the candidate has no valid entry label
economic_primitives.entry_fill_time: e=t+1 completed minute; the single position slot is reserved when BUY is committed at t and cash/premium accounting occurs at e
economic_primitives.descriptive_mark: executable bid B_u at each completed future minute u>e; the entry-fill minute is never also a descriptive exit mark
economic_primitives.realized_exit_fill: EXIT decided at completed minute v fills at completed minute x=v+1 at executable bid B_x; all oracle and serial realized PnL uses B_x
economic_primitives.fee_application: the single $3 round-trip overlay is subtracted once from every marked-to-exit PnL (it covers both entry and exit legs); no per-leg double counting
economic_primitives.premium_at_risk_usd: A_e * M (actual one-contract cash outlay at the t+1 fill; capped maximum loss and return denominator)
economic_primitives.fee_adjusted_dollar_pnl_at_u: PnL$(u) = (B_u - A_e) * M - F for u>e
economic_primitives.breakeven_condition: PnL$(u) > 0 <=> B_u > A_e + F/M (fee-adjusted strict inequality)
economic_primitives.no_bid_full_loss_bound: when no executable B_u exists, PnL$(u)=-(A_e*M)-F and R(u)=PnL$(u)/(A_e*M)
economic_primitives.dual_representation_rule: every family target is emitted in BOTH fee-adjusted dollars per contract AND fee-adjusted return on entry premium, so cheap OTM (explosive %) and expensive ATM/ITM (larger $) cannot each win on only one axis

horizon_window_definition: let entry-fill minute e=t+1. For finite horizon h, W(t,h)={completed minutes u:e<u<=e+h} intersected with u<=15:55 ET. Thus the first descriptive mark is t+2 and a fully available h-minute horizon contains h marks. remaining_session is {u:e<u<=15:55}. Exact endpoints are inclusive at e+h and 15:55 and exclusive at e.

session_boundaries.forced_flat_nonduplication: a committed 15:54 EXIT fills once at 15:55 and suppresses forced-flat for that position; otherwise forced-flat values the still-open position once at the 15:55 boundary

censoring_rules.near_close: if nominal e+h extends past 15:55, retain only W(t,h) through 15:55, set censored=true, and record nominal_minutes and available boundary. Never invent marks beyond the forced-flat boundary.
censoring_rules.time_to_event_censoring: the primary time-to-first-profit clock starts at entry fill e. If no qualifying minute occurs, it is right-censored at last_W_u-e; decision-relative ttfp is report-only and equals primary_ttfp+1 when defined.

missing_minute_rule.definition: a minute u with missing, nonpositive, stale-beyond-max_quote_age, or otherwise non-executable bid is a no-executable-bid minute
missing_minute_rule.primary_no_bid_convention: include the minute at the full-loss bound PnL$(u)=-(A_e*M)-F; it is underwater, contributes full-loss depth to downside/underwater/stability families, breaks profitable runs, and can never be a first-profit minute
missing_minute_rule.forced_flat: use the actual 15:55 boundary state with no earlier-bid substitution; if no executable bid exists, option realization value is $0 and net PnL is the full-loss bound
missing_minute_rule.no_forward_fill: no missing/no-bid minute is forward-filled, interpolated, or replaced by an earlier executable bid
missing_minute_rule.mnar_sensitivity: future evaluation must report no-bid-as-loss versus no-bid-excluded labels; candidate ranking must not depend on the convention

tie_breaking.argmin_argmax_minute: when several minutes attain the extremum, select the earliest (smallest u)
tie_breaking.threshold: profit threshold uses strict inequality PnL$(u) > 0

a_early_drawdown.worst_return: EarlyDD_return(h) = min over u in W(t,h) of R(u)
a_early_drawdown.worst_dollars: EarlyDD_dollars(h) = min over u in W(t,h) of PnL$(u)
a_early_drawdown.quantile_representation: emit the lower-tail quantile vector of {R(u): u in W(t,h)} and {PnL$(u)} at q in {0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25} where q=0.00 is the min; quantiles over available (unmasked) minutes only, linear interpolation
a_early_drawdown.argmin_minute: earliest u attaining the min (tie rule)

b_time_to_first_real_profit.definition: primary TTFP(h)=min{u-e:u in W(t,h), PnL$(u)>0}; e=t+1 is the actual entry-fill minute
b_time_to_first_real_profit.report_only_variant: decision-relative TTFP=min{u-t}; never used for training, composing, or promotion
b_time_to_first_real_profit.first_profit_size: record PnL$ and R at the first-profit minute u* in both units
b_time_to_first_real_profit.censoring: if no qualifying minute in W(t,h), right-censor primary TTFP at last_W_u-e with censored=true; no-bid minutes never qualify

c_pre_profit_adverse_excursion.definition_return: PPAE_return(h) = min over u in W(t,h) with u < u* of R(u), where u* = first-profit minute
c_pre_profit_adverse_excursion.definition_dollars: PPAE_dollars(h) = min over u in W(t,h) with u < u* of PnL$(u)
c_pre_profit_adverse_excursion.never_profitable: if no u* in the horizon, PPAE is the min over the full available window (whole-window adverse excursion)
c_pre_profit_adverse_excursion.immediate_profit: if u*=e+1 (the first legal descriptive mark), the pre-profit window is empty; PPAE=0 with immediate_profit=true

d_underwater_burden.underwater_minute: u is underwater iff PnL$(u) < 0 (equivalently R(u) < 0); fee-adjusted breakeven
d_underwater_burden.depth_duration_integral_dollars: UWI$(h) = sum over underwater u in W(t,h) of (-PnL$(u)) * 1_minute
d_underwater_burden.depth_duration_integral_return: UWI_ret(h) = sum over underwater u in W(t,h) of (-R(u)) * 1_minute
d_underwater_burden.total_underwater_minutes: count of underwater unmasked minutes in W(t,h)
d_underwater_burden.longest_continuous_underwater_interval: max run length of consecutive underwater minutes; masked or non-underwater minutes break the run

e_profitable_window_stability.fraction_positive_minutes: frac_pos(h) = |{u in W(t,h): PnL$(u) > 0}| / |{u in W(t,h): unmasked}|
e_profitable_window_stability.longest_profitable_window: max run length of consecutive positive minutes
e_profitable_window_stability.one_minute_jitter_sensitivity: jitter(h) = max( |frac_pos_shift(+1) - frac_pos(0)|, |frac_pos_shift(-1) - frac_pos(0)| ), where shift(k) replaces each B_u by B_{u+k} (masked if the neighbor is unavailable); lower = more stable
e_profitable_window_stability.unit_note: positive/negative classification is unit-agnostic; PnL$ and R agree on sign

f_upside.mfe_return: MFE_return(h) = max over u in W(t,h) of R(u)
f_upside.mfe_dollars: MFE_dollars(h) = max over u in W(t,h) of PnL$(u)
f_upside.upper_quantiles: emit upper-tail quantiles of {R(u)} and {PnL$(u)} at q in {0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 1.00} where q=1.00 is MFE
f_upside.profit_area_dollars: ProfitArea$(h) = sum over u in W(t,h) with PnL$(u) > 0 of PnL$(u) * 1_minute
f_upside.profit_area_return: ProfitArea_ret(h) = sum over u in W(t,h) with R(u) > 0 of R(u) * 1_minute
f_upside.argmax_minute: earliest u attaining the max (tie rule)

prohibited_here: computing any of these targets on real recorded/historical market data (that is FT2-05)
perfect-hindsight exit minute, max-future-price, or lifecycle-selected exit as an ENTRY target (authority 4.4)
any future bid/ask/spread/greeks/context as a runtime feature

recorder_gap_study_deferred_spec.comparison: first executable ask/bid at approximately decision+5s versus the next completed-minute executable ask/bid used by this label contract
recorder_gap_study_deferred_spec.outputs: paired fill-price and PnL deltas by premium, spread, phase, and fast-market regime; report-only
recorder_gap_study_deferred_spec.subminute_historical_purchase: deferred campaign-2 owner decision; not authorized by FT2-08-REPAIR

worked_example_reference: synthetic examples in report.md use decision t, actual entry ask A_(t+1), marks beginning t+2, M=100, and F=3; no real data is touched
